children: Incap Corporation | Press Release | November 04, 2026 at 10:00:00 EET

Incap Corporation will host a Capital Markets Day for investors, analysts and media representatives on 17 November 2026 at 4:00 p.m. EET. At the event, Incap’s management will present the company’s business, financial performance, and growth strategy. Registration for on-site participation is open until 8 November.

The Capital Markets Day will take place at Flik Event Studio Eliel in Sanomatalo (Töölönlahdenkatu 2, 00100 Helsinki, Finland). The presentations can also be followed via a live webcast, with the opportunity to submit questions during the event. The event will be held in English.
Event agenda (local time, EET):
Registration
Opening: Philip Stoten, journalist
Global EMS market trends: Dieter Weiss, in4ma
Presentations: President and CEO Otto Pukk and CFO Antti Pynnönen
Panel discussion: Incap’s regional Presidents Murthy Munipalli (Asia Pacific), Ralf Hasler (Europe) and Otto Pukk (Americas and the rest of the world), and David Spehar, Managing Director of Incap US
Updates in investor communication: CCAO Helena Maripuu
Summary and closing
Drinks and networking
Recordings and presentation materials will be available on Incap’s website after the event.
Registration
Register for Incap’s Capital Markets Day: https://incap.events.inderes.com/cmd-2026
For on-site participation, please register by 8 November 2026. Registration for webcast participants will remain open until the event date.
INCAP CORPORATION
Additional information:
Otto Pukk, President and CEO, tel. +372 508 0798
Incap in brief

Incap Corporation is a trusted partner and global full-service provider in Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS). Incap supports customers from large multinationals and mid-sized companies to small start-ups across their entire value chain, from design and engineering to manufacturing. Incap offers state-of-the-art technology supported by an entrepreneurial culture and highly skilled personnel. The company has operations in Finland, Estonia, India, Slovakia, the UK, USA, Germany, Romania and Hong Kong and employs over 3,000 people. Incap’s share has been listed on Nasdaq Helsinki since 1997.
